game.name: X-Men : The Official Game (Europe)(Es,It)
game.desc: X-Men: The Official Game for Xbox 360 is an action game based on the film X-Men: The Final Confrontation. Set the scene, control three of the mutants: Wolverine, Diablo and Iceman. It is also possible to join forces with other X-Men for a specific action. Fight the forces of evil that have taken over Jean Grey to save her and your race or face extinction. Use the characters' own abilities to get through.
